resources.string: Shaped board: holes have no cells, gems fall straight through them. Make matches where the cells are.
Leaves: green cells with a leaf badge. A leaf is cleared when a gem pops on its cell.
Double leaves (number 2): pop a gem on the cell twice to clear them.
Ice: a frozen gem cannot move or fall. Match it or blast a bonus over it - the ice cracks.
Double ice (with a snowflake): the first hit cracks it, the second one breaks it.
Gold deposits: stone blocks full of gold. Make a match right next to a deposit or blast a bonus over it. The number shows hits left; a broken deposit frees its cell.
Hard deposits take 2-3 hits. Each hit adds cracks and lowers the number.
Score goal: reach the target score (the star in the goals). Cascades multiply points.
Gold deposits - blocks instead of gems: hit them with a match next to them or a blast. The number shows hits left
Shaped boards: holes have no cells, gems fall straight through them
Match3 updated: new star rules, gem rewards and new board shapes. Progress has been reset.
